newsitem.title: CANADA: Pursuit, Aztec agree to merge.
newsitem.headline: Pursuit, Aztec agree to merge.

text.p: Pursuit Resources Inc and Aztec Resources Ltd said on Tuesday they agreed in principal to merge to merge into a new company called New Pursuit and that their boards would recommend acceptance to their shareholders.

For each Aztec common share held, shareholders would receive either one New Pursuit common share and 0.25 of a New Pursuit share purchase warrant, or C$2.70 cash and 0.25 of a warrant, to a maximum of C$12 million in cash.
Each Pursuit shareholder would receive one common share of New Pursuit for each 2.7 Pursuit common shares, the companies said.
Each warrant would entitle the holder to purchase one New Pursuit common share at C$3.37 a share until June 30, 1998.
The companies said the officers and directors of Pursuit would become officers and directors of New Pursuit, with two nominees of Aztec becoming directors of New Pursuit.
